coverage: complete-stream prefix only; not the full Wikipedia snapshot
method: Cold client metadata on each run; title-to-byte-range hints and roots supplied locally; no manifest request counted; sequential authenticated navigation; no speculative payload fetch. Layout order rotates. Time includes verified byte retrieval, excludes bzip2 extraction. HTTP headers/TLS bytes and decompressor memory excluded. Payload buffer is actual full covering interval; proof buffer is peak fetched batch, not total process RSS. Upstream caches are not controlled.
